title: CAD Agent observable reasoning and decision flow
summary: The workflow turns a user request into bounded context, a strict registered-tool plan, deterministic source checks, and either a verified no-change completion or a validated canonical edit.

nodes.label: 1 · Request Intent
nodes.description: Nest accepts the user request, conversation tail, project, and optional authoritative part link as one durable edit job.

details.responsibility: Preserve the exact requested change and identity scope that every later reasoning step must honor.

inputs.name: messages
inputs.description: A bounded conversation ending with request_text.

inputs.name: requested_part_id
inputs.description: An optional authoritative linked CAD part.

outputs.name: edit_job
outputs.description: Durable workflow identity, scope, mode, state, and retry budget.

guarantees: A linked requested_part_id cannot be redirected to another part.
Public progress records milestones, not prompts or private model deliberation.

nodes.label: 2 · Workflow Mode Gate
nodes.description: The accepted source state fixes initial-design or established-edit behavior before a model is asked to plan.

details.responsibility: Select the legal prompt and tool-plan shape without letting OpenAI choose its own authority.
decisionPoints: Validation diagnostics or planning_feedback → append repair instructions for the same workflow mode.
guarantees: Initial design requires exactly one write_initial_model operation.
Established editing never receives whole-model replacement authority.

nodes.label: CAD Tool Jobs
nodes.description: Postgres cad_tool_jobs durably carries bounded context, apply-plan, and repair-context work between Nest and Python.

details.responsibility: Make every Nest-to-Python reasoning support step leased, retry-safe, and inspectable.
durableWrites: apply_plan requests and candidate or no-change results
prepare_repair_context requests and structured diagnostic context
guarantees: This is the durable handoff; a WebSocket is never the work queue.

nodes.label: 3 · Bounded Context
nodes.description: Python resolves the allowed part and extracts only the source identities, dependencies, targets, and fingerprints needed to plan.

details.responsibility: Turn accepted source plus the user request into authoritative planning context without changing source.
steps: Resolve the linked part exactly, or require one unambiguous project match.
Read accepted model.py and verify its indexed identity.
Inventory semantic features, editable parameters, build_model, allowed targets, and deletable provenance.
Derive dependency paths, parameter consumers, impact candidates, and metadata warnings.
Return the accepted source SHA-256 and current target fingerprints.

outputs.name: source_context
outputs.description: Bounded feature, parameter, dependency, target, and hash context.

failureConditions.condition: The target is missing, ambiguous, stale, or outside the linked scope.
failureConditions.outcome: Planning stops before OpenAI is called.

nodes.label: 4 · Structured Planning Request
nodes.description: Nest combines the workflow-specific instructions with the original request and bounded context, then requests one schema-constrained plan.

details.responsibility: Define what the model may consider and the exact structured response it must produce.

inputs.name: source_context
inputs.description: Authoritative Python-produced scope, graph, source hashes, and fingerprints.

inputs.name: latest_validation
inputs.description: Structured diagnostics on repair attempts, otherwise null.

inputs.name: planning_feedback
inputs.description: Typed tool-preflight feedback on replanning attempts, otherwise null.

steps: Load the shared CAD source contract.
Add the registered tool catalog.
Add initialization or established-edit planning rules.
Append repair rules only when structured feedback exists.
Request ToolPlan schema version 2 as structured output.
guarantees: The model receives no database or storage credentials.
Prompts and complete source bodies are not emitted to public progress.

nodes.label: 5 · OpenAI Structured Planner
nodes.description: OpenAI returns one versioned ToolPlan containing only registered operations, bounded arguments, a summary, and dependency impact decisions.

details.responsibility: Choose the smallest sufficient registered operation set from the supplied bounded context.
decisionPoints: Is this initial construction, an established edit, or a repair attempt?
Which semantic feature or shared parameter expresses the requested geometric intent?
Which dependent features are modified or verified compatible?
Does accepted source definitely satisfy the request, allowing confirm_no_change?

outputs.name: ToolPlan
outputs.description: target_part_id, base source hash, summary, operations, and impact_review.

guarantees: Only the 13 operation types declared by ToolOperationSchema are available for planning.
The model cannot write source, execute Python or CadQuery, validate geometry, commit canonical source, or complete the edit job.

nodes.label: 6 · Nest Plan Gate
nodes.description: Nest parses the structured response and rejects an invalid workflow shape, part target, or base-source identity before execution.

details.responsibility: Prove that the model response is a legal ToolPlan for the server-selected workflow and current context.
preconditions: ToolPlan parses against the workflow-specific Zod schema.
base_source_sha256 equals the bounded context hash.
Initial design and confirm_no_change exclusivity rules hold.
details.shortCircuit: Malformed or out-of-scope model output fails before an apply_plan job is queued.

nodes.label: 7 · Python Plan Gate
nodes.description: Python independently rebuilds the accepted-source inventory and verifies every operation, impact decision, fingerprint, and no-change citation.

details.responsibility: Treat the model plan as untrusted input and authorize only registered, source-current operations.
steps: Re-read the exact base path and compare the whole-source SHA-256.
Verify target part, operation schema, ownership, target kinds, and fingerprints.
Derive and compare the complete dependency impact set.
Reject duplicate, overlapping, unassembled, out-of-scope, or stale operations.
For confirm_no_change, verify every semantic ID and current function-body fingerprint.

failureConditions.condition: A repairable feature-target or impact-review preflight fails.
A terminal scope, source, or contract check fails.
failureConditions.outcome: The job fails without a candidate.

nodes.label: 8 · Outcome Decision
nodes.description: Nest accepts only a verified no-change result or an isolated candidate path and SHA-256 proof from the Python worker.

details.responsibility: Choose the legal terminal or validation path from the typed tool result.
decisionPoints: outcome=no_change plus matching plan, base hash, and non-empty verified evidence → no-change completion.
Valid candidate path plus candidate SHA-256 → independent validation.

nodes.label: 9A · No-change Completion
nodes.description: The request is completed against unchanged accepted source with explicit semantic evidence and empty changed-file and changed-symbol lists.

details.responsibility: Make an already-satisfied request a first-class truthful outcome instead of fabricating an edit.
preconditions: Python verified each cited semantic feature and function-body fingerprint.
details.shortCircuit: No candidate, candidate validation, commit, post-edit reindex, or export is queued.
details.successCondition: The edit job records outcome=no_change and preserves the accepted source hash.

evidence.symbol: confirmed no-change completes without candidate validation, commit, reindex, or export

nodes.label: 9B · Candidate Transaction
nodes.description: Python applies every approved operation in memory, validates the final source contract, and writes one complete edit-scoped candidate.

details.responsibility: Convert an approved ToolPlan into one isolated candidate without partial durable edits.
steps: Normalize semantic feature operations to current internal targets.
Apply all non-delete operations in memory.
Apply eligible provenance-backed deletions in memory.
Validate required imports, ModelParams, build_model, and source ownership contracts.
Write and hash-verify one attempt-specific candidate model.py.
guarantees: An earlier successful operation never becomes a durable partial candidate if a later operation fails.

nodes.label: 10 · Independent Validation
nodes.description: The separate CAD Validator executes the exact candidate identified by path and SHA-256 and returns structured proof or diagnostics.

details.responsibility: Check syntax, source policy, runtime build behavior, model contract, and artifact shape independently of planning.
guarantees: Planning success is never treated as geometry or execution proof.
The proof is bound to the exact edit job, candidate path, and candidate SHA-256.

nodes.label: 11 · Validation Decision
nodes.description: Nest compares the returned proof to the current candidate and chooses commit, repair, or terminal failure.

details.responsibility: Keep model planning separate from the authority to accept source.
decisionPoints: Exact completed passed proof → guarded commit.
Failed report with repairable_hint=true and attempts remaining → prepare repair context.
Non-repairable report or exhausted attempt budget → fail without commit.

operations.retry: At most three candidate attempts, including the first.

nodes.label: 12 · Repair Context
nodes.description: Python verifies the failed candidate identity and returns its exact previous ToolPlan, source context, and structured validator diagnostics for replanning.

details.responsibility: Turn a repairable failure into bounded evidence for the next plan without indexing or accepting the failed candidate.

inputs.name: previous_plan
inputs.description: The exact ToolPlan that produced the failed candidate.

outputs.name: repair source_context
outputs.description: Current candidate inventory plus previous plan and diagnostics.

guarantees: The failed candidate remains isolated and never enters the accepted semantic index.

nodes.label: 13 · Proof-gated Completion
nodes.description: Nest commits only the exact validated candidate while canonical source still matches the accepted base hash, then reindexes and queues export.

details.responsibility: Promote one independently proven candidate and publish the final durable workflow outcome.
preconditions: Validation job, edit job, candidate path, and candidate SHA-256 all match.
Candidate bytes still match the validated candidate SHA-256.
steps: Write and verify canonical source.
Require a successful post-commit semantic reindex.
Queue best-effort export against the committed source hash.
Persist completion and public milestone events.

details.payload: request_text, bounded messages, requested_part_id, and server-selected workflow_mode

details.trustBoundary: Only bounded context crosses to the external model; the model receives no source mutation or workflow completion authority.

details.payload: workflow mode, base storage path, attempt, and the exact parsed ToolPlan

edges.label: claim plan and return typed result

response.label: candidate proof, no-change proof, or typed failure

details.failureBehavior: Only allowlisted repairable preflight codes trigger another plan; source remains unchanged.

preconditions: the validation attempt budget is not exhausted

boundaries.label: NestJS CAD Agent control plane
boundaries.description: Owns workflow mode, prompt composition, OpenAI request/response parsing, orchestration decisions, public progress, proof checks, and completion.

boundaries.label: Python CAD Tool Worker
boundaries.description: Owns deterministic context extraction, plan preflight, no-change evidence checks, repair-context preparation, and transactional candidate construction.
